results.title: empty script
results.methodology: Same-process runs of real Rhino scripts. Each run's engines are tracked from EngineLifecycleCallback.onEngineCreate to onEngineRemove through weak references only. After every run the runner calls Runtime.gc and System.runFinalization 3 times and polls up to pollMs (1 s once 3 runs stayed reachable); a final collection decides 'retained'. Heap deltas compare the sample after the last warm-up with the final sample; thread, Rhino context and engine deltas compare with the sample before the first run. Force mode waits for gateReady() (and all expected engines), sleeps forceDelayMs and calls forceStop on every live engine of the run on the main thread. Measurements are the temporary test implementation of ROADMAP P0.2.
